notes: All 15 discovery and diamond records audited for ranking evidence. Five provisional qualitative high bands and ten unknown bands; no very_high or moderate tier was invented to complete a ladder. No fee, review or scope fields are replaced by these patches.

High means an explicit nonroutine methodological/theoretical or broad disciplinary contribution hurdle with editorial screening in the relevant sociology/organization niche. These are agent judgments about stated editorial demands, not validated ordinal rankings or manuscript-specific acceptance probabilities. Unknown is an evidence limitation, not an easier tier.

Metrics are official non-null reported values only. Three official acceptance displays are retained with null year and explicit period/cohort limitations. Organization Studies and Acta Sociologica do not expose the denominator in the readable overview; The Sociological Review defines final decisions in the previous calendar year but never names that year. No check date was substituted for a metric year.

CMOT and Sociológia explicitly identify 2025 citation values. Network Science's citation table is undated and remains so; its separate article-count introduction explicitly names 2024. Citation impact, publication volume, review targets and first-decision speeds do not establish acceptance difficulty.

No year-qualified citation metrics were confirmed for the other journals in this bounded official-source search. Several Sage overview pages were inaccessible or timed out, and direct ordinary requests returned 403. These access limits are not claims that the journal never discloses metrics. No access controls were bypassed.

English-only M@n@gement verified-free conditions, Sociológia's prohibition of AI-generated scholarly content, CMOT unresolved non-APC charges and Network Science's conditional gold-OA waiver remain as established by discovery/fees. Funding conditions cannot establish editorial ease.
Only the assigned ranking/sociology-organizations.json file was written. No venue contact, submission, remote write, installation, publication or human scientific validation was performed.
